```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# Load world map polygons for drawing the interactive map in Observable JS
ne_small <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "small", returnclass = "sf") |>
  mutate(code = tolower(ifelse(iso_a2_eh != "-99", iso_a2_eh, iso_a2))) |>
  select(code, name, geometry)

tf <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")
st_write(ne_small, tf, driver = "GeoJSON", quiet = TRUE)
world_geojson <- paste(readLines(tf, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")

# Load detailed country metadata and compute land area + global rankings
ne_med <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  mutate(
    code = tolower(ifelse(iso_a2_eh != "-99", iso_a2_eh, iso_a2)),
    area_km2 = round(as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6)
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    area_rank = min_rank(desc(area_km2)),
    pop_rank = min_rank(desc(pop_est))
  )

# Get currency and ISO-3 codes from countrycode
cl <- countrycode::codelist |>
  transmute(
    code = tolower(iso2c),
    cl_name = country.name.en,
    currency = currency,
    iso3 = iso3c
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(code)) |>
  distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Get capital cities from maps::world.cities
capitals <- maps::world.cities |>
  filter(capital == 1) |>
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode::countrycode(country.etc, "country.name", "iso3c", warn = FALSE)) |>
  filter(!is.na(iso3)) |>
  arrange(desc(pop)) |>
  distinct(iso3, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(iso3, capital_city = name)

# Fallback coordinates, capitals, and facts for territories and UK nations
extra <- tribble(
  ~code, ~extra_name, ~extra_region, ~extra_capital, ~extra_currency, ~lon_ex, ~lat_ex, ~extra_fact,
  "bq", "Caribbean Netherlands", "Caribbean (Americas)", "Kralendijk (Bonaire)", "US Dollar", -68.26, 12.17, "Consists of three special municipalities of the Netherlands in the Caribbean: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, and Saba (home to Mount Scenery, the highest point in the Kingdom of the Netherlands).",
  "bv", "Bouvet Island", "South Atlantic Ocean", "None (uninhabited)", "Norwegian Krone", 3.36, -54.42, "An uninhabited subantarctic volcanic island and dependency of Norway, often described as the most remote island on Earth—over 1,600 km from the nearest land.",
  "cc", "Cocos (Keeling) Islands", "Indian Ocean (Oceania)", "West Island", "Australian Dollar", 96.83, -12.16, "An Australian external territory made up of two coral atolls and 27 islands, of which only West Island and Home Island are inhabited.",
  "cx", "Christmas Island", "Indian Ocean (Oceania)", "Flying Fish Cove", "Australian Dollar", 105.69, -10.45, "An Australian territory in the Indian Ocean famous for the annual migration of around 40 to 50 million red land crabs from the forest to the coast.",
  "gb-eng", "England", "Northern Europe", "London", "Pound Sterling", -1.17, 52.36, "The largest and most populous country of the United Kingdom, home to London, Stonehenge, and the St George's Cross flag dating back to the Middle Ages.",
  "gb-nir", "Northern Ireland", "Northern Europe", "Belfast", "Pound Sterling", -6.49, 54.79, "Part of the United Kingdom in the northeast of the island of Ireland, famous for the Giant's Causeway of roughly 40,000 interlocking volcanic basalt columns.",
  "gb-sct", "Scotland", "Northern Europe", "Edinburgh", "Pound Sterling", -4.20, 56.49, "Covers the northern third of Great Britain and includes more than 790 islands; its Saltire flag (St Andrew's Cross) is one of the oldest national flags still in use.",
  "gb-wls", "Wales", "Northern Europe", "Cardiff", "Pound Sterling", -3.78, 52.13, "A mountainous country of the United Kingdom with more castles per square mile than almost anywhere else in the world and a famous Red Dragon (Y Ddraig Goch) on its flag.",
  "gf", "French Guiana", "South America", "Cayenne", "Euro", -53.13, 3.93, "An overseas department of France on the northeast coast of South America, densely covered in equatorial rainforest and home to Europe's spaceport at Kourou.",
  "gi", "Gibraltar", "Southern Europe", "Gibraltar", "Gibraltar Pound", -5.35, 36.14, "A British Overseas Territory at the southern tip of the Iberian Peninsula, dominated by the Rock of Gibraltar and home to Europe's only wild monkey population (Barbary macaques).",
  "gp", "Guadeloupe", "Caribbean (Americas)", "Basse-Terre", "Euro", -61.55, 16.27, "A butterfly-shaped archipelago and French overseas region in the southern Caribbean Sea, dominated by the active La Soufrière volcano.",
  "mq", "Martinique", "Caribbean (Americas)", "Fort-de-France", "Euro", -61.02, 14.64, "A rugged Caribbean island and overseas region of France, famous for Mount Pelée and a rich blend of French and Antillean Creole culture.",
  "re", "Réunion", "Eastern Africa (Indian Ocean)", "Saint-Denis", "Euro", 55.54, -21.12, "A French island department in the Indian Ocean east of Madagascar, home to Piton de la Fournaise, one of the most active volcanoes on Earth.",
  "sj", "Svalbard and Jan Mayen", "Northern Europe (Arctic)", "Longyearbyen", "Norwegian Krone", 20.98, 77.55, "Norwegian Arctic islands far north of mainland Europe; Svalbard houses the Global Seed Vault and is famous for having more polar bears than permanent residents.",
  "tk", "Tokelau", "Polynesia (Oceania)", "Fakaofo (rotating)", "New Zealand Dollar", -171.86, -9.20, "A remote dependent territory of New Zealand consisting of three tropical coral atolls in the South Pacific that became the first territory powered 100% by solar energy.",
  "um", "U.S. Minor Outlying Islands", "Pacific & Caribbean", "None (administered from Washington, D.C.)", "US Dollar", -169.53, 16.75, "Eleven small United States island territories—eight in the Pacific Ocean (including Midway and Wake Atolls) and three in the Caribbean Sea—mostly protected as wildlife refuges.",
  "yt", "Mayotte", "Eastern Africa (Indian Ocean)", "Mamoudzou", "Euro", 45.17, -12.83, "An overseas department of France in the Mozambique Channel between Madagascar and mainland Africa, surrounded by one of the world's largest coral lagoons."
)

country_data <- tibble(file = list.files("flags", pattern = "\\.png$")) |>
  mutate(code = sub("\\.png$", "", file)) |>
  left_join(ne_med, by = "code") |>
  left_join(cl, by = "code") |>
  left_join(capitals, by = "iso3") |>
  left_join(extra, by = "code") |>
  mutate(
    display_name = coalesce(extra_name, cl_name, name_en, name),
    region_label = coalesce(
      extra_region,
      ifelse(!is.na(subregion) & !is.na(continent), paste0(subregion, " (", continent, ")"), continent)
    ),
    capital_label = coalesce(extra_capital, capital_city, "No official capital"),
    currency_label = coalesce(extra_currency, currency, "Local / regional currency"),
    lon = round(coalesce(label_x, lon_ex), 2),
    lat = round(coalesce(label_y, lat_ex), 2),
    hemisphere = paste0(
      ifelse(lat >= 0, "Northern", "Southern"), " & ",
      ifelse(lon >= 0, "Eastern", "Western"), " Hemisphere"
    ),
    fact = ifelse(
      !is.na(extra_fact),
      extra_fact,
      paste0(
        ifelse(!is.na(formal_en) & formal_en != display_name,
               paste0("Officially known as the ", formal_en, ", "),
               paste0(display_name, " is ")),
        "located in ", region_label, ". ",
        "It covers about ", format(area_km2, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " km² (#", area_rank, " in size globally) ",
        "with an estimated population of ", format(round(pop_est), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " (#", pop_rank, " worldwide)",
        ifelse(!is.na(capital_city), paste0(", and its capital city is ", capital_city), ""),
        ifelse(!is.na(currency), paste0(". Its official currency is the ", currency), ""),
        ifelse(!is.na(name_ja) & !is.na(name_ar),
               paste0(". Around the world, its name is written as \"", name_fr, "\" in French, \"", name_ar, "\" in Arabic, and \"", name_ja, "\" in Japanese."),
               ".")
      )
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    file, code,
    name = display_name,
    region = region_label,
    capital = capital_label,
    currency = currency_label,
    hemisphere, lon, lat, fact
  ) |>
  arrange(name)

ojs_define(
  countries_raw = country_data,
  world_geojson = world_geojson
)
```

```{ojs}
// Convert R data frame and GeoJSON into JavaScript objects
countries = transpose(countries_raw)
world = JSON.parse(world_geojson)

// Let the user select a country from the dropdown or click "Surprise Me!"
mutable picked = countries.find(d => d.code === "us") ?? countries[0]

viewof dropdown = Inputs.select(countries, {
  label: "Select a country or territory:",
  format: d => `${d.name} (${d.code.toUpperCase()})`,
  value: picked
})

viewof randomBtn = Inputs.button("🎲 Surprise Me (Random Flag)", {
  reduce: () => {
    const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * countries.length);
    mutable picked = countries[idx];
  }
})
```

```{ojs}
// Keep selected synced when the user picks from the dropdown
selected = dropdown
```

```{ojs}
// Deterministic pseudo-random helper so each country gets consistent distractors
function makeOptions(correct, pool, seedStr) {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seedStr.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + seedStr.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  }
  const others = Array.from(new Set(pool.filter(x => x && x !== correct)));
  const chosen = [];
  let step = 0;
  while (chosen.length < 3 && others.length > 0) {
    const idx = (hash + step * 97) % others.length;
    const candidate = others[idx];
    if (!chosen.includes(candidate)) chosen.push(candidate);
    step++;
  }
  const all = [correct, ...chosen];
  return all.sort((a, b) => {
    const ha = (a.charCodeAt(0) * 17 + hash) % 101;
    const hb = (b.charCodeAt(0) * 17 + hash) % 101;
    return ha - hb || a.localeCompare(b);
  });
}

regionOptions = makeOptions(
  selected.region,
  countries.map(d => d.region),
  selected.code + "-reg"
)

capitalOptions = makeOptions(
  selected.capital,
  countries.map(d => d.capital).filter(c => c !== "No official capital"),
  selected.code + "-cap"
)

currencyOptions = makeOptions(
  selected.currency,
  countries.map(d => d.currency).filter(c => c !== "Local / regional currency"),
  selected.code + "-cur"
)
```

### 🏳️ Flag & Country Trivia

Test your knowledge about **${selected.name}** below! Pick an answer for each trivia question to unlock your score and the full country profile.

```{ojs}
// Display the flag next to the interactive trivia quiz
html`<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; align-items: center; margin: 1rem 0;">
  <div>
    <h3 style="margin-top: 0;">${selected.name} (${selected.code.toUpperCase()})</h3>
    <img src="flags/${selected.file}" alt="Flag of ${selected.name}" style="max-width: 100%; max-height: 250px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);">
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f0f4f8; padding: 1.1rem; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #1d3557;">
    <strong>🧭 Quick Hint:</strong> Located in the <em>${selected.hemisphere}</em> at coordinates (${selected.lat}°, ${selected.lon}°). Answer the 3 questions below!
  </div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
viewof ansRegion = Inputs.radio(regionOptions, {
  label: `1. Which region is ${selected.name} in?`
})

viewof ansCapital = Inputs.radio(capitalOptions, {
  label: `2. What is the capital of ${selected.name}?`
})

viewof ansCurrency = Inputs.radio(currencyOptions, {
  label: `3. Which currency is used in ${selected.name}?`
})
```

```{ojs}
// Check answers and show interactive feedback + interesting facts
{
  const checks = [
    {
      num: 1,
      topic: "Region",
      ans: ansRegion,
      correct: selected.region
    },
    {
      num: 2,
      topic: "Capital",
      ans: ansCapital,
      correct: selected.capital
    },
    {
      num: 3,
      topic: "Currency",
      ans: ansCurrency,
      correct: selected.currency
    }
  ];

  const answeredCount = checks.filter(c => c.ans !== null && c.ans !== undefined).length;
  const correctCount = checks.filter(c => c.ans === c.correct).length;

  return html`<div style="background: #f8f9fa; padding: 1.25rem; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid ${correctCount === 3 ? "#2a9d8f" : "#e63946"}; margin: 1rem 0;">
    <h4 style="margin-top: 0;">Trivia Score: ${correctCount} / 3 (${answeredCount} answered)</h4>
    <ul style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
      ${checks.map(c => {
        if (!c.ans) return html`<li><strong>Q${c.num} (${c.topic}):</strong> <em>Select an answer above</em></li>`;
        if (c.ans === c.correct) return html`<li style="color: #1b7a6e;"><strong>Q${c.num} (${c.topic}):</strong> ✅ Correct! (${c.correct})</li>`;
        return html`<li style="color: #c1121f;"><strong>Q${c.num} (${c.topic}):</strong> ❌ "${c.ans}" is not right — try another choice!</li>`;
      })}
    </ul>
    <details ${answeredCount > 0 ? "open" : ""}>
      <summary style="cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; color: #1d3557;">📖 Interesting Facts about ${selected.name} (click to toggle)</summary>
      <p style="margin-top: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0; line-height: 1.55;">${selected.fact}</p>
    </details>
  </div>`;
}
```

### 🌍 Interactive World Map

Switch between a full world map and a rotatable 3D globe centered on **${selected.name}**, and hover over any country to inspect it!

```{ojs}
viewof mapProjection = Inputs.radio(
  ["Equal-Earth World Map", "3D Globe (Centered on Country)"],
  { label: "Map View:", value: "Equal-Earth World Map" }
)
```

```{ojs}
// Draw an interactive map with hover tooltips and a projection toggle
Plot.plot({
  title: `Where ${selected.name} is in the world (${selected.lat}°, ${selected.lon}°)`,
  projection: mapProjection === "3D Globe (Centered on Country)"
    ? { type: "orthographic", rotate: [-selected.lon, -selected.lat] }
    : "equal-earth",
  width: 860,
  height: mapProjection === "3D Globe (Centered on Country)" ? 520 : 460,
  marks: [
    Plot.sphere({ fill: "#eef6fa", stroke: "#b8d4e3" }),
    Plot.graticule({ strokeOpacity: 0.18 }),
    Plot.geo(world, {
      fill: d => d.properties.code === selected.code ? "#e63946" : "#d8e2dc",
      stroke: "#ffffff",
      strokeWidth: 0.5,
      title: d => `${d.properties.name} (${d.properties.code.toUpperCase()})`
    }),
    Plot.dot([selected], {
      x: "lon",
      y: "lat",
      r: 8,
      fill: "#e63946",
      stroke: "#ffffff",
      strokeWidth: 2.5,
      tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.name}\nRegion: ${d.region}\nCapital: ${d.capital}`
    }),
    Plot.text([selected], {
      x: "lon",
      y: "lat",
      text: d => d.name,
      dy: -14,
      fontWeight: "bold",
      fill: "#1d3557",
      stroke: "#ffffff",
      strokeWidth: 3
    })
  ]
})
```
